definitions.explanation: The process of killing bacteria and microorganisms to make something sterile or germ-free.

examples.japanese: {殺菌|さっきん}⟦{効果|こうか}→効果：01176_kouka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00092_takai⟧。
{熱|ねつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{殺菌|さっきん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。

notes:
{殺菌|さっきん} refers to killing bacteria and microorganisms.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {殺菌|さっきん}する (to sterilize)
- {殺菌|さっきん}{効果|こうか} (sterilization effect)
- {殺菌|さっきん}{作用|さよう} (antibacterial action)
- {殺菌|さっきん}{処理|しょり} (sterilization treatment)

RELATED TERMS:
- {消毒|しょうどく}: disinfection
- {滅菌|めっきん}: sterilization (complete)
- {抗菌|こうきん}: antibacterial
- {除菌|じょきん}: germ removal
